title: Night run: gauntlet all on gemma4:12b for the main-model comparison
goal: Every model pack has a gemma4:12b result from the same release and limits as gemma4:26b, so the owner chooses the main model on one comparison
acceptance: Owner 2026-11-27: "Keep 26b, test more"; planned as the 2026-11-29 night in gauntlet-protocol docs/NIGHTS.md ("gauntlet all on gemma4:12b")

In a night model plan on a quiet Mac (no owner use of the local model), from a development worktree at origin/main with node_modules installed, never ~/.nerv-app; OUT is a new private directory outside any checkout

node tools/gauntlet.mjs all --fresh --profile=node_modules/@voidbrain/gauntlet-protocol/examples/profiles/gemma4-12b.json --allow-models --execute --out-dir=$OUT/f126-t07-12b-all (without --allow-expensive: the expensive system cases are F-120-T08). Plan on 2026-11-27: 16 model packs, 154 cases, at most 133.5 min of suite time
`all` records validating reports in the worktree's evals/gauntlet/ledger.json; that change goes into a reviewed PR the next morning (check:gauntlet-ledger passes), never pushed overnight
A comparison table (gemma4:12b against gemma4:26b per pack) is added to docs/evaluations/2026-11-26-f126-t02-gemma4-26b-gauntlet.md and summarised in F-126 for F-126-T03
privacy: Local models only; no paid route, prompts are neutral fixtures, raw reports stay private on their base.
escalation: A model run needs a quiet Mac and the owner's night plan; a material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27: up to about 2 h 15 min of model time overnight, then the ledger PR and a comparison table. Not a measurement.
